we_claim.name: EIC Fund (equity)
we_claim.administering_body: European Innovation Council Fund (managed for the Commission by EISMEA)
we_claim.why_offered: row carries capital_type=equity and an EIC funder URL, but the corpus holds no award amounts and no award dates, so it falls below the brief's data floor and is dropped from every founder's pool

funder_says: The EIC Fund is the equity arm that invests in companies selected through EIC Accelerator calls. The Accelerator call is continuously open with fixed 2026 batching cut-offs; the investment component is EUR 1M to 10M, and the EIC-STEP Scale Up compartment invests EUR 10M to 30M. A founder applies through the EU Funding & Tenders portal; there is no direct approach to the Fund and no requirement to bring a lead investor.
quote: The EIC Fund is an alternative investment fund (AIF) that has been established for the specific purpose of investing in companies selected through EIC Accelerator calls. ... Investment component of EUR 1M up to 10 million for scaling up and other activities. ... Equity investment component of EUR 10 up to 30 million for scaling up strategic technologies for Europe. ... This call is continuously open, and applications can be submitted at any time.
window: Continuous submission with full-proposal batches during 2026: 7/01/2026; 04/03/2026; 06/05/2026; 08/07/2026; 02/09/2026; 04/11/2026. EIC-STEP Scale Up: one batch per quarter 11/02/2026; 06/05/2026; 09/09/2026; 25/11/2026. Short applications batched the first Tuesday of every month at 17h00 Brussels time.
basis: the EIC's own EIC Accelerator page and the official EIC Work Programme 2026 PDF (https://eic.ec.europa.eu/system/files/2025-11/EIC-Work-Programme-2026.pdf), both read 2026-08-13

corroboration.source: European Innovation Council Work Programme 2026 (Commission Decision C(2026) 4080 annex)
corroboration.note: call table gives EIC Accelerator budget EUR 414 million for 2026 and EIC-STEP Scale Up EUR 300 million

access_mode_basis: a published call with eligibility criteria, a submission platform (EU Funding & Tenders portal) and fixed cut-off dates; the Fund only invests in companies already selected through those calls, and no lead or co-investor is required of the applicant
published_ticket: Investment component of EUR 1M up to 10 million for scaling up and other activities. Grant component below EUR 2.5M for innovation activities (TRL 6 to 8). EIC-STEP Scale Up: Equity investment component of EUR 10 up to 30 million.

funder_says: EIFO (Denmark's Export and Investment Fund) is live and takes applications through a single customer portal. Its early-stage co-investment product, the Matchlan, matches a private investor's investment 1:1 and publishes both entry criteria and a facility size of DKK 500,000-3,000,000 (exceptionally DKK 5,000,000). A private investor must already be in place. Direct equity is offered too, but no equity ticket range is published; EIFO states that all its solutions are always financed together with a partner.
quote: Facilitetsstoerrelse 500.000-3.000.000 DKK (i saertilfaelde kan et Matchlaan oeges til 5.000.000 DKK). ... For at ansoege om et Matchlaan skal virksomheden: vaere registreret i Danmark og have et dansk CVR-nummer; have en innovativ og skalerbar forretningsmodel; have genereret mindre end 3 mio. DKK i akkumuleret omsaetning; have modtaget investering fra en uafhaengig, ekstern investor; have minimum 12 maaneders runway efter investering/finansiering og have positiv egenkapital. ... Faelles for alle loesninger er, at EIFO altid finansierer sammen med en partner. ... Naar du er blevet klogere paa, hvilken type finansiering, du oensker at soege om, skal du indsende din ansoegning via EIFOs faelles ansoegningsportal, Kundeportalen.
window: none stated; rolling application via Kundeportalen, with a stated reply 'inden for et par dage'
basis: EIFO's own Matchlan page, its 'Saadan ansoeger du' page (https://eifo.dk/kontakt-os/saadan-ansoeger-du), its early-stage company page and its Matchlan product sheet PDF (https://eifo.dk/media/po4fxxvq/matchlaan.pdf), all read 2026-08-13
access_mode_basis: EIFO publishes entry criteria and a common application portal (Kundeportalen) plus a Matchlan application form, so a founder submits rather than waits to be selected; but a private co-investor must already be committed ('have modtaget investering fra en uafhaengig, ekstern investor', and the assessment explicitly weighs 'lead investor og investorkreds')
published_ticket: Facilitetsstoerrelse 500.000-3.000.000 DKK (i saertilfaelde kan et Matchlaan oeges til 5.000.000 DKK). Loebetid: som udgangspunkt 6 aar, dog max 10 aar. Praemie: CIBOR3 + 5%. [Matchlan only; EIFO publishes no ticket range for its direct equity investments.]

funder_says: Almi Invest is open and publishes both a ticket range and a public pitch form. It normally invests SEK 1-4 million in the first round and SEK 5-10 million from its GreenTech fund, and it states that it can never invest alone: a private co-investor is always required.
quote: Almi Invest investerar normalt 1-4 miljoner kronor i foersta rundan, och vaar GreenTech-fond investerar 5-10 miljoner kronor. ... Vi investerar alltid tillsammans med andra investerare. ... Foer att vara aktuellt foer investering ska bolaget vanligtvis: Vara i pre-seed, seed eller tidig tillvaextfas; Ha potential att vaexa utanfoer Sverige; Loesa ett verkligt kundproblem paa en stor marknad; Vara ett registrerat aktiebolag i Sverige; Vara oeppet foer medinvesteringar tillsammans med andra investerare. ... Skicka in din pitch.
window: none stated; rolling submission via the 'Pitcha din startup' form (https://www.almi.se/almi-invest/pitcha-din-startup/), which states 'Vi laeser varje inskickad pitch'
basis: Almi's own riskkapital page and its pitch-submission form, read 2026-08-13
access_mode_basis: a public structured submission form with mandatory fields (org number, region, round size, pre-money valuation, pitch deck upload) and published eligibility criteria; a private co-investor is mandatory ('Vi investerar alltid tillsammans med andra investerare'), though no named lead investor is demanded
published_ticket: Almi Invest investerar normalt 1-4 miljoner kronor i foersta rundan, och vaar GreenTech-fond investerar 5-10 miljoner kronor.

funder_says: High-Tech Gruenderfonds is open, takes pitch decks through a public upload, and publishes both its ticket size and its eligibility criteria. It states it acts as lead investor and finds co-investors itself, so no lead investor is required of the founder; the company must be no older than three years and headquartered in or operating from Germany.
quote: The sweet spot of our initial investments in pre-seed and seed is EUR 800,000+. We invest flexibly - depending on your needs. As a lead investor, we work with many partners: we will find suitable co-investors for you from our national and international network. In growth rounds, we can invest up to EUR 30 million in a startup from our portfolio. ... We invest in early-stage companies that are no older than three years. ... Your startup is headquartered in Germany or - in the case of start-ups from other countries - has a German base of operations.
window: none stated; rolling submission via 'My pitch' (https://www.htgf.de/en/pitch-deck-upload/)
basis: HTGF's own homepage 'Our investment criteria' section and its pitch-deck upload route, read 2026-08-13
access_mode_basis: a public pitch-deck upload plus published, testable criteria (age <3 years, German base, named sectors, ticket size); HTGF explicitly takes the lead role itself and sources co-investors, so no lead investor need be in place
published_ticket: The sweet spot of our initial investments in pre-seed and seed is EUR 800,000+. ... In growth rounds, we can invest up to EUR 30 million in a startup from our portfolio.

funder_says: CDP Venture Capital SGR, Italy's national venture capital manager (Rome and Milan), is open and runs a public 'Applica ora' submission portal at pitch.cdpventurecapital.it. It publishes per-fund investment criteria and per-fund endowments (for example Fondo Artificial Intelligence 450 Mln EUR, Fondo Technology Transfer 380 Mln EUR), but it deliberately does not publish a per-company ticket range: it says only that each fund has a dedicated ticket size. Selection is described as selective and discretionary.
quote: Ogni Fondo, con una durata tra 10 e 15 anni, adotta una propria strategia di investimento e un ticket size dedicato. ... Criteri d'investimento: Investiamo in maniera selettiva e discrezionale su tre principali direttrici: In startup da fase 'early stage' a 'growth'; In startup che abbiano l'ambizione di diventare Campioni sulla scena globale attraverso l'utilizzo di una tecnologia deeptech; In Poli di trasferimento tecnologico, in collaborazione con universita e centri di ricerca, per favorire la nascita delle startup. ... 450 Mln EUR Dotazione [Fondo Artificial Intelligence] ... 380 Mln EUR Dotazione [Fondo Technology Transfer]
window: none stated; rolling submission via the 'Applica ora' portal at https://pitch.cdpventurecapital.it
basis: CDP Venture Capital's own fund pages and its October 2025 Italian brochure (https://cds.cdpventurecapital.it/cdpventurecapital/public/cms/documents/BrochureITA_ott25.pdf), read 2026-08-13
access_mode_basis: a public submission portal ('Applica ora' -> pitch.cdpventurecapital.it) with published per-fund investment criteria; no co-investor or lead investor is stated as required, but the criteria are explicitly 'selettiva e discrezionale', so the apply route is thinner than a call

funder_says: This row is CDP Venture Capital's fund-of-funds arm: FoF VenturItaly (465 Mln EUR) and FoF VenturItaly II (475 Mln EUR), plus a FoF Internazionale (305 Mln EUR). The funder's own page states these invest in venture capital funds, not in companies, with the explicit purpose of professionalising the Italian national venture capital market. A founder cannot approach it at all; only a fund manager can. The vehicle itself is live - VenturItaly II is the successor to the 2020 first fund of funds.
quote: FONDI DI FONDI - VenturItaly e VenturItaly II. Fondi di Fondi che investono in fondi di Venture Capital lungo tutta la filiera, dal Seed al Late stage. Focus in tre categorie di fondi: first time team/first time fund, fondi avviati da nuovi team all'interno di gestori gia attivi e fondi successivi di gestori consolidati. I FoF si propongono di supportare proattivamente la creazione di fondi a elevato livello professionale, contribuire alla sostenibilita del mercato nel lungo periodo, generare ritorni finanziari per gli investitori e professionalizzare il mercato del Venture Capital nazionale ... DOTAZIONE 465 Mln EUR FoF VENTURITALY ... DOTAZIONE FoF VENTURITALY II 475 Mln EUR
window: none stated; the funder publishes no submission window for fund managers
basis: CDP Venture Capital's own 'I nostri fondi' page and October 2025 brochure, read 2026-08-13. The vehicle is live and open to fund managers, but by the funder's own description it is not a thing a company applies to: it subscribes to third-party VC funds. Its awards belong to those funds, not to founders.
mismatch: the corpus records country FI for this row while the sibling row cdp_vc_equity is IT. CDP Venture Capital SGR S.p.A. is registered in Rome (Piazza Giuseppe Verdi 10, 00198 Roma; Registro delle Imprese di Roma, P. IVA 08480100018) with a Milan office, and the fund-of-funds' stated purpose is 'professionalizzare il mercato del Venture Capital nazionale' i.e. the Italian market. FI is a defect; the country must be IT.
access_mode_basis: the page describes subscribing to third-party venture capital funds as a limited partner; there is no founder-facing route at all, and the only counterparties are fund managers

funder_says: Invest-NL is open and publishes four numbered investment criteria, an excluded-scope list and a Funding Check submission route backed by a downloadable business plan template. It states it is a co-financier with a minimum funding requirement of EUR 10 million for companies, and publishes an explicit ticket band of EUR 5-25 million per fund for its fund investments (funds of at least EUR 50 million). It does not finance companies in the seed phase.
quote: As a co-financier, we focus on innovative enterprises and projects with (eventually) a minimum funding requirement of EUR 10 million. ... Invest-NL focuses on funds with an intended total size of at least EUR 50 million. We participate with tickets between EUR 5 million and EUR 25 million per fund. ... Additionality: Invest-NL is looking for financing solutions that cannot be obtained through regular market channels. Preferably with professional investors and in an early stage together with Regional Development Agencies (ROMs). ... Outside our investment scope: We do not finance companies in the seed phase. We do not provide grants and only finance for new economic activities, so acquisitions are excluded. ... We look forward to receiving your completed business plan via the Funding check.
window: none stated; rolling submission via the Funding check (https://www.invest-nl.nl/en/our-approach/financing/funding-check)
basis: Invest-NL's own direct-financing, funding-check and fund-investments pages, read 2026-08-13
access_mode_basis: published numbered criteria, a stated exclusion list and a Funding Check submission form with a business plan template; Invest-NL calls itself a co-financier and prefers professional investors and ROMs alongside, but the page states no hard lead-investor precondition
published_ticket: As a co-financier, we focus on innovative enterprises and projects with (eventually) a minimum funding requirement of EUR 10 million. ... Invest-NL focuses on funds with an intended total size of at least EUR 50 million. We participate with tickets between EUR 5 million and EUR 25 million per fund.
